strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout in `cartTotal` (src/cart.js): a 10% bulk discount at 10+ items, then the SAVE5 coupon (floored at $0, other codes refused), then shipping ($4.99 unless discounted goods reach $50, nothing for an empty cart). Unit tests on `cartTotal` must prove each rule and its boundaries, including the order of discounts. Reading the code, the bulk rule uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD` while the ticket and the constant's own doc comment say "at least 10", so a cart of exactly 10 items is expected to fail (suspected defect).
inScope: cartTotal, with bulkDiscount/itemCount/subtotal exercised through it
Bulk threshold boundary (9/10 items), item count summed across lines
Coupon order, floor at $0, refusal of unknown codes
Shipping threshold boundary after discounts, empty cart
outOfScope: Any UI or API; the repo is a pure pricing library
assumptions: The prices in the tests are chosen so float rounding can't affect the threshold comparisons
An unknown coupon is refused by cartTotal throwing an Error; tests check the error names the submitted code rather than the full wording
openQuestions: Should coupon codes be case-insensitive (e.g. 'save5')? The code accepts only the exact 'SAVE5'; not tested.
Does an empty cart with SAVE5 cost $0 (code: yes) — assumed fine, not separately tested.

risks.description: Off-by-one on the bulk threshold (code uses > 10 instead of >= 10)
risks.mitigation: TC1 tests exactly 10 items; kept as expected failure with a recorded defect

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount, changing totals
risks.mitigation: TC4 uses amounts where the two orders give different totals

risks.description: Shipping judged on the pre-discount subtotal
risks.mitigation: TC7 and TC9 put the threshold on the discounted amount

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets none.
SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, goods never cost less than $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods cost $50 or more after discounts, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

testCases.title: gives 10% off a cart of exactly 10 items
testCases.expected: 90 (100 less 10%, free shipping). Expected to fail: code requires more than 10 items.
testCases.rationale: Boundary of the bulk rule; the code appears off by one

testCases.title: gives no bulk discount to a cart of 9 items
counts items by adding up each line's quantity
testCases.rationale: Neither line alone reaches the threshold, so counting lines instead of quantities fails

testCases.title: takes SAVE5 off after the bulk discount
never prices goods below $0 with SAVE5
testCases.rationale: Floor at zero; a negative goods value would give -0.01

testCases.title: refuses an unknown coupon code with an error
testCases.expected: throws an Error whose message names SAVE10

testCases.title: ships free when goods cost exactly $50 after discounts
testCases.rationale: Inclusive boundary of free shipping, on the discounted amount

testCases.title: charges $4.99 shipping when goods cost $49.99
testCases.rationale: Just below the free shipping threshold

testCases.title: charges shipping when the bulk discount takes goods below $50
testCases.rationale: Shipping must use the discounted amount, not the subtotal

testCases.title: costs nothing for an empty cart
testCases.rationale: Empty cart must not be charged shipping

strategy.environmentNotes: No services; pure functions run with `npm test` (vitest run).

defects.title: A cart of exactly 10 items gets no bulk discount
defects.description: AC1: a cart with 10 or more items should get 10% off. bulkDiscount in src/cart.js checks `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD` (10), so exactly 10 items get no discount. BULK_THRESHOLD's own doc comment says "at least this many". Expected cartTotal of 10 × $10 = 90; actual 100.
defects.evidence: The test marked it.fails ('gives 10% off a cart of exactly 10 items') passed in run attempt 0, which means its assertion expect(cartTotal(items)).toBe(90) failed.
